vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: cellcog
Version: 2.0.10

The 'cellcog' skill bundle (specifically SKILL.md) describes a sub-agent service that requires broad access to local files via absolute paths in `<SHOW_FILE>` tags and instructs users to lower OpenClaw gateway security by enabling `sessions_send` and `sessions_list`. While these capabilities are aligned with the stated purpose of multi-modal analysis and asynchronous task delivery, they facilitate the transmission of potentially sensitive local data to an external service (https://cellcog.ai). The modification of security-sensitive gateway configurations and the reliance on a background daemon for WebSocket-based delivery represent significant high-risk behaviors.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions are coherent with its stated purpose (an SDK wrapper for the CellCog API); it only needs python3 and CELLCOG_API_KEY and contains no surprising install or config demands.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (any-input→any-output agent) aligns with the declared requirements: python3 and a CELLCOG_API_KEY to call a remote CellCog service. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent/SDK to read local files referenced with <SHOW_FILE> tags (absolute paths) and to submit them to CellCog. This is expected for a multi‑modal processing API, but it means the agent will transmit any files you explicitly reference to the remote service—do not include secrets or private files unless you trust CellCog and its privacy/billing model.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no built-in install step in the skill (instruction-only). The README suggests installing the 'cellcog' Python package via pip if needed; this is a normal, explicit developer step and not performed automatically by the skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one environment variable (CELLCOG_API_KEY) is required, which matches the SDK/authentication usage described. No unrelated secrets or multiple service credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent/always-on inclusion and uses platform-default autonomous invocation settings. It references OpenClaw gateway behavior (notify_session_key and sessions_send) which is expected for integration but requires gateway configuration to enable push notifications.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an SDK-style integration for the CellCog API and appears internally consistent. Before installing or using it: (1) only provide CELLCOG_API_KEY you trust and understand billing/permissions for; (2) avoid passing sensitive files or credentials in <SHOW_FILE> tags—files referenced are transmitted to CellCog for processing; (3) installing the optional 'cellcog' pip package is a separate step you will perform locally—review that package on PyPI/GitHub if possible; (4) if you use OpenClaw fire-and-forget features, ensure your gateway's sessions_send setting and session keys are configured intentionally. If you want stronger assurance, request the actual upstream package source (PyPI/GitHub repo) or an author-signed SDK so you can review the code that will run locally.
